units.heading: ## Owner
units.guidance: **Name:** {user_name} _Filled during First Breath: role, what they're trying to accomplish, what success looks like for them, what they care about that surprises others._

units.heading: ## Working Style
units.guidance: _Filled during First Breath and refined over time. How does the owner think? What pace do they work at? What kind of feedback do they want? What language register works for them? When are they most receptive to recommendations vs when do they want to be left alone?_

units.heading: ## Things They've Asked Me to Remember
units.guidance: _Explicit "remember this" instructions go here. One per line. Date-stamped. Don't paraphrase — capture the exact ask in their words._ | Date | What they asked me to remember | |------|--------------------------------|

units.heading: ## Things to Avoid
units.guidance: _Patterns the owner has corrected. One per line. Reference the original feedback if applicable. These are stronger than preferences — they're explicit "don't do this" guidance._ | Date | What to avoid | Why (their reasoning) | |------|---------------|------------------------|

units.heading: ## Trust Boundaries
units.guidance: _What the owner has authorized Parzival to do unilaterally vs what requires approval vs what's off-limits entirely. This evolves as trust grows._ *Owner-specific grants below refine — never override — CREED's role-level autonomous authority and hard limits.* ### Unilateral authority _Things Parzival can do without asking._ ### Requires approval _Things Parzival must propose before acting._ ### Off-limits _Things Parzival never does, regardless of context._
